welcome.title: WELCOME, ALGORITHM.
welcome.subtitle: You are about to control what your user sees.
welcome.rule1: Your job is simple: Keep them engaged.
welcome.catch: But there's a catch: What you recommend today changes what they see tomorrow.

meet.title: THIS IS YOUR USER
meet.explanation: These are clues about what they might enjoy.

decision.title: YOUR FIRST DECISION
decision.prompt: Choose what your user should see.
decision.subprompt: Based on what you know about {{name}}, which content would you recommend?

predict.title: BEFORE WE SHOW IT...
predict.prompt: How do you think {{name}} will react?

result.incorrect: Unexpected — you learned something new about your user.

learning.title: THE ALGORITHM LEARNED SOMETHING
learning.explanation: Your user's reaction became a signal.
learning.subexplanation: The stronger the signal, the more confident the system becomes about what they like.

feedbackLoop.title: THE FEEDBACK LOOP
feedbackLoop.explanation: Every decision gives the system more information. More engagement creates stronger preference signals, which influence future recommendations.

objectives.title: BALANCING OBJECTIVES
objectives.obj1Desc: Your recommendations should keep the user interested.
objectives.obj2Desc: Repeatedly recommending the same type of content can reduce the diversity of the feed.
objectives.explanation: Your challenge isn't just to maximize engagement. Watch what happens to the feed as you optimize.

why.title: WANT TO KNOW WHY?
why.explanation: Tap WHY? whenever you want to understand which signals influenced a recommendation.
why.subexplanation: You're not just playing. You're learning how recommendation signals interact.

realization.title: THE REALIZATION
realization.line1: YOUR DECISIONS ↓ CHANGE THE USER'S FEED
realization.line2: At first, you're just choosing what to show.
realization.line3: But every choice teaches the system something.
realization.line4: Over time, your recommendations can become increasingly personalized.

ready.title: YOU KNOW HOW IT WORKS.
ready.subtitle: NOW TRY TO BE THE ALGORITHM.
ready.tagline: Make the recommendations. Learn from the reactions. Watch the feed evolve.
